name: Leap API
description:
One API for the best image, video and audio models. Every request goes to `https://api.tryleap.ai` with your API key in the `x-api-key` header, or as `Authorization: Bearer leap_...`. Create a key at https://app.tryleap.ai/go/api.

Guides, examples and the errors list are at https://www.tryleap.ai/docs.
